description: Local install only: copies bundled Cursor skills from mcp-runrunit (cursor-skills/) into ~/.cursor/skills or project .cursor/skills (os.homedir). Use when the user wants to sync skills onto their machine (onboarding, pull package skills locally). Prefer dry_run:true first. NOT for sharing via GitHub or “compartilhar / dividir com o time” in the repo — that is runrunit_share_cursor_skill. Optional skill_names, categories (platform/technology/utility), target global|project, project_root, source_dir. Use runrunit_list_cursor_catalog to discover ids.

categories.description: Optional category filters (AND across dimensions). Example: { "platform": ["runrunit"] }.

dry_run.description: If true, only lists what would be copied (no writes). Recommended before first sync.

project_root.description: Absolute path to the project root when target is project. Ignored when target is global.

skill_names.description: Optional skill ids to copy (e.g. registrar-evidencias). Intersects with categories when both are set. If omitted, copies all matching categories or everything.

source_dir.description: Optional absolute path to a cursor-skills directory. If omitted, resolves next to the installed mcp-runrunit package.

target.description: global = ~/.cursor/skills (default). project = <project_root>/.cursor/skills — requires project_root when target is project.

name: runrunit_install_cursor_skills
